# GitHub Copilot instructions - SignalFlow Lab

Before doing any work:

1. Start at [BUILDER_KICKOFF.md](../BUILDER_KICKOFF.md), then
   [FLOW_MODULE_PLAYBOOK.md](../FLOW_MODULE_PLAYBOOK.md).
2. Run `npm run check` before every commit and keep it green. Never weaken a
   check to make it pass.
3. Honor the design rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): simple, polished,
   minimal text; one "Fix this next".
